title: A Computational Framework for AI-Driven Generation and Psychometric-Based Personalization of Educational Content

contributions.purpose: 提出 LLM 建题 + 心理测量参数播种方法
contributions.mechanism: LLM 生成 30 题 AP 化学题库,单一 SME 人工核验并播种 IRT 参数
contributions.evaluation: 定性核验(题目事实准确、符合教学);仅 1 名 SME(自认局限)
contributions.source_quote: A methodology for using LLMs to create a domain-specific question bank and seed it with initial psychometric parameters.

contributions.purpose: 设计可复现的模拟学习环境
contributions.mechanism: Python 仿真,10,000 虚拟学生 θ_true 抽自标准正态,IRT 模型生成作答
contributions.evaluation: 作为自适应算法测试床
contributions.source_quote: The design of a reproducible simulated learning environment to serve as a testbed for adaptive algorithms.

contributions.purpose: 证明 IRT 个性化优于基线
contributions.mechanism: IRT 自适应 vs 随机 vs 固定难度,N=10,000 仿真 t 检验
contributions.source_quote: A large-scale computational experiment demonstrating that the framework produces statistically significant and robust performance gains across all learner subgroups

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends this by not only generating questions but also integrating them into a dynamic, adaptive framework

notes: 3 条自声明贡献。红旗:(1)循环自证——虚拟学生作答由同一 IRT 模型生成,自适应算法又按 IRT 选题,“个性化更优”近乎构造性必然,评测为同环境自证;论文自己承认“cannot disentangle” IRT 机制与题目质量;(2)全仿真无真实学生,N=10,000 使 p<0.0001 平凡显著;(3)元数据标题(“AI-Driven Generation and Evaluation ... AP Chemistry ... Proof-of-Concept”)与 PDF 正文标题(“Computational Framework ... Psychometric-Based Personalization”)不一致。trade-off/负结果:高能力组 Q4 提升仅 +1.3pp。作者主动定位为 proof-of-concept、需真人后续实验,较诚实但证据力弱。
